name: wordpress-cost-calculator-builder
description: Generates production-grade, highly localized, standalone copy-and-paste WordPress cost calculators (HTML/CSS/JS) optimized for header right, desktop, tablet, and mobile viewports. Features deep logo color extraction, centered title-only header block (badges/subtitles omitted), strict #FFFFFF background, all-dropdown text-type architecture with concise options (< 35 chars), hidden-by-default custom stepper (+/- increments), container-query 2-column anti-truncation grid, lightbox results modal with Astra-immune circular close button, 5-second auto-close countdown with hover pause, anti-cascade specificity protocol (zero inline display:none blocking), itemized line items, visual proportional cost bar, dual side-by-side conversion CTAs (Book Free Site Walk + Call Direct), revoked print bloat, 100% valid JSON-LD schema, and automated minification.
author: Bluejaypro Telemetry & Conversion Engineering Team
